<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .
@prefix vocab: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .

############################
# Shape for Ship instances #
############################

vocab:ShipShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass vocab:ship ;
    # ---- upperIceWaterlineDisplacement (Quantity) ----
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;                     # expects a QuantityValue node
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        # unit must be kt
        sh:property [
            sh:path qudt:unit ;
            sh:hasValue unit:KiloTON_Metric ;
        ] ;
        # numeric value must be decimal
        sh:property [
            sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
            sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
        ] ;
    ] ;
    # ---- hasUpperIceWaterlineCase relationships (with nested case validation) ----
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ;
        sh:class vocab:upperIceWaterlineCase ;
        sh:node [
            # ---- waterlineCaseDisplacement (Quantity) ----
            sh:property [
                sh:path vocab:waterlineCaseDisplacement ;
                sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
                sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
                # unit must be kt
                sh:property [
                    sh:path qudt:unit ;
                    sh:hasValue unit:KiloTON_Metric ;
                ] ;
                # numeric value must be decimal
                sh:property [
                    sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
                    sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
                ] ;
            ] ;
        ] ;
    ] ;
    # ---- SPARQL constraint: ship displacement must be the maximum of its waterline cases ----
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "The upper‑ice‑waterline displacement (DUI) must equal the greatest displacement among the associated waterline cases." ;
        sh:select """ 
            PREFIX sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#>
            PREFIX vocab: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>

            SELECT $this WHERE {
                $this vocab:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement ?shipQty .
                ?shipQty qudt:numericValue ?shipVal .
                $this vocab:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ?case .
                ?case vocab:waterlineCaseDisplacement ?caseQty .
                ?caseQty qudt:numericValue ?caseVal .
            }
            GROUP BY $this ?shipVal
            HAVING ( ?shipVal != MAX(?caseVal) )
        """ ;
    ] .

#############################
# Unresolved ownership note #
#############################
# The property vocab:upperIceWaterline is mentioned in the source but its ownership
# cannot be resolved from the supplied ontology. No shape is generated for it,
# preserving the ambiguity as required.
<END_SHACL>
